text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT triggered — high error-rate & latency on /v1/generate for model-redwood/tp-xl across tp-sharded clusters in us-west-2. Thresholds: 5xx > 2% and p95 latency > 1.2s. Auto-runbooks started. Severity: P1. :rotating_light:

anya_oncall: I'm on it. seeing NCCL timeouts in the node logs and huge KV cache growth on a subset of shards. paging eng-ml and ops.

matt_eng: confirmed. KV cache eviction didn't kick in; continuous-batching config seems to have applied a new aggressive dynamic_batching profile at 03:12 UTC that increases max_batch_tokens to 2048. likely causing uneven prefix accumulation across tensor-parallel shards. logs: ```
2026-03-15T03:18:02Z ERROR nccl: NCCL timeout while waiting for comm on rank 3
2026-03-15T03:18:03Z WARN kv_cache: shard=3 size=1.9GB growth=+450MB/60s
2026-03-15T03:18:04Z ERROR serve: handler /v1/generate timeout
```

raja_ml: that growth + NCCL stalls smells like skewed key distribution after the recent kv-shard hashing tweak. looks like shard 3/8 got >60% of active prefixes.

kim_ops: can we isolate nodes? I'm watching NCCL errors correlate with node set gpu-5,gpu-6 in cluster-rw-west-2a. NVLink traffic spiking.

anya_oncall: immediate mitigations: 1) disable continuous batching for the affected model, 2) force kv shard rebalance, 3) fall back traffic to a compatible single-shard variant while we heal. Doing step 1 now (toggle via config service).

deploy-bot: deploy request queued: rollback-config dynamic_batching for model model-redwood/tp-xl by anya_oncall to commit 1f3a2b. Canary target: 2 nodes. ETA ~2m.

matt_eng: runbooks: run `rdw ctl kv evict --model model-redwood/tp-xl --shard 3 --force` to reduce memory pressure, then `rdw ctl kv rebalance --model model-redwood/tp-xl --policy round_robin --force` to re-shard. also set `REDWOOD_CONTINUOUS_BATCHING=off` on canary.

anya_oncall: started eviction on shard 3. command output: ```
> rdw ctl kv evict --model model-redwood/tp-xl --shard 3 --force
Evicting 4.1M prefixes... completed 4.1M/4.1M. Freed 1.7GB.
```

raja_ml: even after eviction, we may have hot keys re-populating. need a hot-key throttle: `kv.hot_key_rate_limit=200rpm` for the model. propose applying to affected traffic group.

kim_ops: can we also kill the NCCL sessions on the two failing nodes to clear stuck collectives? `nvidia-smi topo --matrix` looks ok but ranks are stuck. I'm going to restart the agent on node gpu-5.

ella_custsuccess: FYI, customer impact — three managed customers reported timeouts (prod apps). list: AcmePayments (degraded), Travelly (errors), NotionX (high latency). I'm sending the initial incident banner and will update post-mitigation.

matt_eng: rolling the canary — continuous batching config rollback applied on two canary nodes, traffic cut to fallback variant (single-shard) for ~20% traffic. Observability: p95 dropped from 1.8s to 0.9s on canaries, 5xx dropped from 6.3% to 0.6%.

deploy-bot: rollout status: canary success. rolling to remaining nodes in 3 stages.

anya_oncall: started `rdw ctl kv rebalance` with policy round_robin. watch logs for NCCL re-sync.

matt_eng: patch queued for the hashing layer to avoid skew: small change to consistent-hash fallback when load imbalance >30%. will deploy as non-breaking next patch.

kim_ops: restarted agent on gpu-5 and gpu-6, NCCL errors cleared on those nodes. still seeing a couple more transient timeouts while rebalancing finishes.

raja_ml: applied hot-key throttle and reduced max_batch_tokens from 2048 -> 512 on the model config. also enabled prefix-level caching to prefer local shard lookups.

ella_custsuccess: Sent update to impacted customers: acknowledging issue, mitigation in progress, ETA for stabilization 45m. asking for any VIP escalations.

matt_eng: monitoring — global p95 now 0.95s, 5xx 0.8%. KV cache growth rate flatlined. NCCL error counts back to baseline.

anya_oncall: marking incident as mitigated for user impact. Keeping the page open for validation and a clean handoff to postmortem owners.

incident-bot: Incident status changed to MITIGATED by anya_oncall at 1970001200. Duration: ~2h. Auto-triggering postmortem template.

raja_ml: action items (assigned):
- investigate root cause of hash tweak -> assign raja_ml
- add guardrail to continuous-batching rollout pipeline to reject configs that increase max_batch_tokens > 1024 without mem-sim — matt_eng
- improve hot-key detection and auto-throttle — kim_ops
- customer RCA draft and communications — ella_custsuccess
- add canary test to sharding logic to detect >25% shard skew — eng-platform (matt_eng)

anya_oncall: handing off to matt_eng for post-incident and permanent mitigations. I'll remain available for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:

matt_eng: acknowledged. creating ticket INF-2026-045 and scheduling follow-up sync. thanks everyone for quick responses.

deploy-bot: runbook note added: `kv-shard-skew` remediation steps appended.

ella_custsuccess: updating customers: We'll include timeline and mitigation steps in the follow-up. ETA for customer-facing RCA: 72h.

anya_oncall: closing thread here; if recurrence, re-open and escalate. :lock:
